methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page on 2026-06-14 via WebFetch. Pingdom (pingdom.com) returned HTTP 403 on all direct URL attempts (pricing, signup, solution pages); pricing was sourced from two independent aggregator/review pages (softwareadvice.com, getapp.com) which agree on a $15/month entry point for Synthetic Monitoring — this is noted in provenance and the data is marked as aggregator-sourced. StatusCake displays prices in EUR only; the pricing page confirms invoicing is also accepted in USD but no USD figures are published; EUR monthly figures are recorded and monthlyUsd is set to the EUR amount as a proxy only where a USD equivalent is not directly stated — this is noted in provenance. Better Stack uses a per-seat model for Responder seats with no flat organizational plan; monthlyUsd reflects cost for one Responder seat. Checkly shows the same dollar figures on both monthly and annual toggles; the page states 'annual billing applies the annual discount' but does not publish a separate monthly rate, so the displayed price is treated as the annual billing rate. Site24x7 annual pricing is the primary figure; monthlyUsd reflects the annualized monthly rate with month-to-month rate in notes. All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null throughout — this is a non-telephony vertical.
